items.verse: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
items.verseEn: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

items.verse: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
items.verseEn: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
items.verseEn: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًۭا سَدِيدًۭا
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.

items.verse: وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًۭا وَعَدْلًۭا ۚ لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.verseEn: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

items.verse: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
items.verseEn: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

categories.name: نَعِيمُ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ فِي سُورَةِ الْوَاقِعَةِ
categories.nameEn: Blessings of the Companions of the Right in Surah Al-Waqi'ah

items.verseEn: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

categories.name: جُمُوعُ التَّكْسِيرِ عَلَى وَزْنِ مَفَاعِلَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Broken Plurals on the Pattern مَفَاعِل in the Quran

items.verse: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
items.verseEn: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

items.verse: رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةًۭ مُّسْلِمَةًۭ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.verseEn: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

items.verse: وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
items.verseEn: And [remember] when you, [O Muḥammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uḥud] - and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing -

items.verse: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
items.verseEn: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

harf.hint: A just return from Allah — what each soul receives in proportion to what they did
harf.verse: 56:24 - As reward for what they used to do.

deduction.title: The Trial of Sacred Flame
deduction.intro: In an ancient land where devotion to carved stone had taken root in every home, one individual stood apart. Through unwavering conviction and divine protection, they faced what should have been certain death — and walked away unharmed. Can you uncover the identity of this remarkable soul?
clues: I was raised among people who bowed to idols they had carved with their own hands, believing these objects held divine power.
When I challenged their beliefs, they dismissed me at first, but I could not remain silent about the truth I knew.
On a day when they were gathered away, I destroyed their idols, leaving only the largest one untouched.
When they returned and saw what I had done, their leaders commanded a great pyre to be built, intending to cast me into the flames.
They hurled me into the blazing fire, but the Lord of the worlds commanded it to become cool and safe for me.
I emerged from the flames completely unharmed, while those who plotted against me faced utter ruin.

deduction.arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
deduction.verse: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act." (21:68)

translations: Indeed, I [I] have turned my face
to the One Who created the heavens
and the earth (as) a true monotheist
scramble.hint: Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham's) declaration of pure monotheism — a famous statement recited by Muslims worldwide about turning sincerely to Allah alone.
scramble.arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
scramble.verseEn: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
